description: This file defines an extension method for converting a MembershipTableSnapshot into a ClusterMembershipSnapshot, enabling easier manipulation or retrieval of cluster membership data within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: MembershipTableSnapshotExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for MembershipTableSnapshot objects.

methods.name: CreateClusterMembershipSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a ClusterMembershipSnapshot from the current MembershipTableSnapshot, encapsulating cluster membership details.
